newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fr Telecom in advanced talks with Olivetti.
newsitem.headline: Fr Telecom in advanced talks with Olivetti.

text.p: France Telecom said it was in advanced talks with Olivetti about taking a participation in telecoms joint-venture Infostrada but it could not say when an agreement would be signed.
"We have been in discussions with Olivetti for quite some time. We are in advanced stages. But we prefer not to say when it could be signed, there is still some way to go," a spokesman said.
Italian newspaper La Repubblica said on Friday that France Telecom would "imminently" join the venture and that there was also agreement with 33 percent owner Bell Atlantic.
According to the paper, France Telecom would invest 100 billion lire ($61.4 million). The company spokesman had no comment on the amount. ($ = 1628 Italian Lire)
